test_override_virtual_functions: test overriding C++ virtual functions from Python subclasses using pybind11 trampoline classes
test_alias_delay_initialization: test that pybind11 trampoline classes are only initialized when a Python subclass is created
test_move_support_noncopyable: test move semantics and non-copyable types when overriding virtual functions in Python
test_inherited_virtuals: test overriding virtual functions across multi-level C++ inheritance hierarchies from Python
test_python_override_cache: test that pybind11 correctly caches Python function overrides across repeated calls
